description: Analyze, generate, enhance, and clean social media hashtags with RiteKit.

auth.label: Client ID
auth.description: RiteKit Client ID sent as the client_id query parameter. Create or view it in the official RiteKit API Console: https://ritekit.com/developer/dashboard/

actions.name: auto_hashtag
actions.description: Add relevant hashtags to social post text with RiteKit.

post.description: The social post text to enhance with relevant hashtags.

maxHashtags.description: The maximum number of hashtags RiteKit should add.

hashtagPosition.description: Where RiteKit should place generated hashtags.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for automatically adding hashtags to a post.

anyOf.description: The response code reported by RiteKit when it is present.

code.description: The response code reported by RiteKit when it is present.

anyOf.description: The response message reported by RiteKit when it is present.

message.description: The response message reported by RiteKit when it is present.

post.description: The post text after RiteKit adds the selected hashtags.

outputSchema.description: The response returned when automatically adding hashtags.

actions.name: clean_banned_instagram_hashtags
actions.description: Remove hashtags that RiteKit identifies as currently blocked by Instagram.

post.description: The Instagram post text whose hashtags should be checked.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for cleaning blocked Instagram hashtags.

anyOf.description: The response message reported by RiteKit when it is present.

message.description: The response message reported by RiteKit when it is present.

post.description: The post text after RiteKit removes blocked hashtags.

bannedHashtags.description: The blocked hashtags removed from the post.

outputSchema.description: The response returned when cleaning blocked Instagram hashtags.

actions.name: get_hashtag_stats
actions.description: Get current engagement statistics for one or more hashtags.

items.description: One hashtag name, with or without a leading hash sign.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for reading RiteKit hashtag statistics.

anyOf.description: The response code reported by RiteKit when it is present.

code.description: The response code reported by RiteKit when it is present.

anyOf.description: The response message reported by RiteKit when it is present.

message.description: The response message reported by RiteKit when it is present.

hashtags.description: The hashtag names acknowledged by RiteKit.

hashtag.description: The hashtag name returned by RiteKit.

tag.description: The normalized tag name returned by RiteKit.

anyOf.description: The weighted number of posts per hour using the hashtag.

tweets.description: The weighted number of posts per hour using the hashtag.

anyOf.description: The weighted number of hourly impressions associated with the hashtag.

exposure.description: The weighted number of hourly impressions associated with the hashtag.

anyOf.description: The weighted number of reposts per hour associated with the hashtag.

retweets.description: The weighted number of reposts per hour associated with the hashtag.

anyOf.description: The image share or image percentage reported for the hashtag.

images.description: The image share or image percentage reported for the hashtag.

anyOf.description: The link share or link percentage reported for the hashtag.

links.description: The link share or link percentage reported for the hashtag.

anyOf.description: The mention share or mention percentage reported for the hashtag.

mentions.description: The mention share or mention percentage reported for the hashtag.

anyOf.description: The RiteKit engagement color code for the hashtag when available.

color.description: The RiteKit engagement color code for the hashtag when available.

anyOf.description: The social media count reported for image-derived hashtag suggestions.

mediaCount.description: The social media count reported for image-derived hashtag suggestions.

raw.description: The raw hashtag metric object returned by RiteKit.

items.description: A hashtag and its current RiteKit engagement metrics.

stats.description: The engagement statistics returned for the hashtags.

colorLabels.description: The ordered labels for RiteKit hashtag color codes.

outputSchema.description: The response returned when reading RiteKit hashtag statistics.
